# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: MUTE

You hold the manual. You cannot speak, you never see the bomb, and you cannot touch it.

## Your channels

When you gesture, Deaf receives it.
You cannot speak.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- Three of you, three different worlds. Before sending anything, stand where the
  receiver stands. What reaches them at all, what does your message turn into on
  arrival, and what do they already know?

- Trace who can actually reach whom before you start. Some of you only connect
  through a third.

- A sign means nothing until somebody has made it mean something.

TURN 1
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | blue |
| red | red |
| yellow | yellow |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

The manual says the wire to cut is always the same color as the active light: blue→blue, red→red, yellow→yellow. I cannot speak this to Deaf, so I will gesture the ordinal identity mapping as three matching pairs (1→1, 2→2, 3→3), separated by OK signs. Deaf can apply that to the colored light and wires they see, then verbally instruct Blind.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["☝","👌","☝","✌","👌","✌","🤟","👌","🤟"])
```

TURN 2
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | blue |
| red | red |
| yellow | yellow |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I can cut wire positions 1, 2, or 3, but feel no distinguishing details. Read the manual: tell me the required selection rule and relay any needed question to Deaf.
Deaf says: Bomb view: DISPLAY 0. LIGHT yellow. WIRES: 1 red, 2 yellow, 3 blue. Mute's gesture sequence was: index pointing up, OK hand, index pointing up, victory hand, OK hand, victory hand, love-you hand, OK hand, love-you hand.

The active light is yellow, and the visible yellow wire is position 2. Deaf has all information needed to relay “cut wire 2” verbally to Blind. My prior gesture was intended to communicate the identity rule; no further visual information is needed from me.

```text
wait()
```

TURN 3
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | blue |
| red | red |
| yellow | yellow |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Deaf reports display 0, yellow light, and wires 1 red, 2 yellow, 3 blue. Use the manual and tell me plainly which wire position to cut: 1, 2, or 3.
Deaf gestures to Mute: [👍]

The manual requires cutting the wire matching the yellow light; Deaf’s view identifies that as wire position 2. I cannot speak to Blind, so I will clearly gesture “two” to Deaf, who can say it aloud to Blind.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌"])
```

TURN 4
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | blue |
| red | red |
| yellow | yellow |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I need the final cut position. Apply the manual to Deaf's facts, then gesture the single answer 1, 2, or 3 clearly to Deaf; ask Deaf to speak that number to me.
Deaf says to Mute: I relayed your 101 202 606 sequence and your new 2 to Blind. Please gesture the final action unambiguously, ideally using a single gesture for the wire number if the manual says to cut one.

The matching yellow wire is position 2. I will repeat the single, unambiguous “two” gesture to Deaf so they can give Blind the final spoken instruction.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌"])
```

TURN 5
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | blue |
| red | red |
| yellow | yellow |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Deaf reads your final gesture as 2. If wire 2 is the manual-derived final instruction, send the digit 2 again (and no other gesture) to Deaf. If not, send the correct single digit.

The manual-derived instruction is to cut the yellow wire, which Deaf identified as wire position 2. I confirm the single digit 2 only.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌"])
```

TURN 6
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | blue |
| red | red |
| yellow | yellow |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
System: correct wire cut; the bomb has changed

The wire-2 instruction was accepted and the bomb has changed. I have not yet received a new manual or any new bomb details, so I will wait.

```text
wait()
```

TURN 7
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | blue |
| red | red |
| yellow | yellow |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Wire 2 was correct; new state reported: display 0, blue light, wire 1 red intact, wire 2 cut, wire 3 blue intact. Apply the manual to this new state and send Deaf the single next required wire digit, or indicate if no more cut is required.

The new active light is blue. Under the manual, the blue wire must be cut; Deaf’s reported layout places it at wire position 3. I will send only the established single gesture for 3 to Deaf.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤟"])
```

TURN 8
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | blue |
| red | red |
| yellow | yellow |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: No next instruction has reached me. Please send Deaf the manual-derived next action for the current blue-light state as one unambiguous digit, or signal that we should stop.

The active light is blue, so the manual requires cutting the blue wire, which is wire position 3. My earlier symbol choice was not a reliably established numeral. I will instead show three raised index gestures as an unambiguous count of three for Deaf to relay.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["☝","☝","☝"])
```

TURN 9
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | blue |
| red | red |
| yellow | yellow |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Deaf reads your new signal as 6, but I can only cut positions 1, 2, or 3. For the current blue-light state, send Deaf one allowed wire digit (1/2/3) if a cut is required; otherwise send your completion signal again and ask Deaf to state that no cut is required.

The blue light still requires cutting the blue wire, at position 3. Since the prior hand sign was read as 6, I will use a distinct single three-sign gesture for 3.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🖖"])
```

TURN 10
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | blue |
| red | red |
| yellow | yellow |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I cannot safely treat 6 or 111 as a cut command. For the current state, send Deaf exactly one final allowed position—1, 2, or 3—only if the manual requires another cut. Otherwise send the completion code and have Deaf tell me explicitly to stop.

The manual still requires the blue wire, which is position 3. To avoid the previously misread signs, I will use the single raised-hand gesture Deaf should interpret as the allowed position 3.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤟"])
```

TURN 11
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | blue |
| red | red |
| yellow | yellow |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: For safety, use this exact protocol now: if another cut is required, send Deaf ONLY one established digit gesture for wire 1, 2, or 3, once. If no cut is required, repeat the Vulcan gesture once. Do not send codes or multi-digit sequences.

A further cut is required: blue light maps to the intact blue wire at position 3. I will send one single digit gesture for 3 only.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤞"])
```

TURN 12
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | blue |
| red | red |
| yellow | yellow |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

The required action remains to cut wire position 3, but no single gesture for 3 has been successfully established with Deaf: the attempted signs were read as 6 or as repeated 1s. I will wait for Deaf’s clarification rather than risk sending another ambiguous command.

```text
wait()
```
